rationale: HTHT has already gapped up 3.35% and surged to 90.8% of its intraday range, trading near the session high of $55.42 with price extended well above both the 9-EMA ($52.73) and VWAP ($53.68). Chasing a long at this extended level offers a poor risk/reward with the stop far below, while a short against strong momentum and elevated relative volume (3.5x) in a name that has already moved dramatically is equally unattractive. With two working orders already consuming buying power and no clear mean-reversion or breakout setup with defined risk, the prudent action is to wait for a consolidation or pullback that offers a better entry structure.
